title: SB0983 (110th General Assembly): As enacted, adds and revises provisions regarding the issuance of orders of protection and the carrying of a handgun. - Amends TCA Title 36, Chapter 3, Part 6 and Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2017-05-31; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514071051 of https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/110/pub/pc0468.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Public Chapter 468 (2017-05-31), the law as enacted, printed as House Bill 752 substituted for Senate Bill 983 (twin text). Quotes copied as printed in the scanned text, including OCR errors (e.g. 'othenrise', '$' read as 'S'). Section 4 sets staged effective dates tied to the department of safety driver license system.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 36-3-626): (a) A person who petitions the court and is granted an order of protection, ex parte or othenrise, pursuant to this part is authorized to, for twenty-one (21) calendar days after that order of protection is granted, carry any handgun, as defined in $ 39-17-1319, that the person legally owns or possesses so long as the person has in the person's possession at all times while carrying the handgun a copy of the order of protection.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 36-3-626): (b) A person who does not apply for a temporary handgun carry permit under S 39-17-1365 within the time period set forth in $ 39-17-1365(a) shall not be authorized to carry a handgun under subsection (a) once that time period has expired.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1308(a)): ( ) By a person authorized to carry a handgun pursuant to $ 36-3-626 or $ 39-17- 1 365;
SECTION 3 (new TCA 39-17-1365): (a) A person who petitions the court and is granted an order of protection, ex parte or othenruise, pursuant to title 36, chapter 3, part 6, may apply for a temporary handgun carry permit from the department of safety within twenty-one (21) calendar days after that order of protection is granted.
SECTION 3 (new TCA 39-17-1365): (d) lf an applicant meets all the requirements of this section, the department of safety shall issue a temporary handgun carry permit to the applicant that shall be valid for sixty (60) calendar days from the date of issuance.
SECTION 3 (new TCA 39-17-1365): (e) A person issued a temporary handgun carry permit under this section shall carry that permit and a copy of the protective order at all times when carrying a handgun pursuant to this section.
